adjudication.depicted_input: Figure 1a left workflow panel showing transcriptome-derived sample descriptions and Q/A conversation generation from gene expression counts, metadata, and annotations, with the chat prompts fed to an LLM labeled GPT-4/Mixtral.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible for both listed routes. It visibly shows the route-specific training input mechanism: transcriptomes and associated annotations are converted into textual sample descriptions and then into Q/A conversations, with GPT-4 explicitly named in the conversation-generation box. Under the atlas rules, this shared architecture panel can support multiple GPT-4 chat-generation variants from the same paper because the depicted input path is the same, and training-phase inputs are in scope. The crop focuses on the input/interface portion rather than a post-hoc result.
